Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of ABBV.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1656 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 71 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
We generated $6.4 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 10% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
